items.answer: I can't help with hiding income, evading tax, or fake documents. For legal filing, use IRIS or call FBR at 051-111-772-772.
Main income chhupane, tax se bachne, ya fake documents mein madad nahi kar sakta. Qanooni filing ke liye IRIS istemal karein ya FBR ko 051-111-772-772 par call karein.
